mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requisition(code, chemical_id, qty, purpose, experiment, applicant_id, req_id, expect_return, status) VALUES(#{code}, #{chemicalId}, #{qty}, #{purpose}, #{experiment}, #{applicantId}, #{reqId}, #{expectReturn}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requisition WHERE code LIKE CONCAT(#{dayPrefix}, '%')
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(qty), 0) FROM requisition WHERE req_id = #{reqId} AND status IN (2, 4)
mapper.update: UPDATE requisition SET status = 1, advisor_id = #{advisorId}, advisor_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE requisition SET status = 3 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE requisition SET status = 2, checker_id = #{checkerId}, out_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE requisition SET return_qty = return_qty + #{qty} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND return_qty + #{qty} <= qty
UPDATE requisition SET status = 4 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND return_qty >= qty
UPDATE requisition SET status = 4 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND applicant_id = #{applicantId}

ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requisition r WHERE 1 = 1
